description: This file is a Spring configuration class that sets up batch job components for handling Loan Closings of Business (COB) in the Fineract project. It defines beans for partitioning, steps, and the job itself, integrating various services and listeners relevant to the COB process.

classes.name: LoanCOBManagerConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up Loan COB batch job components, including partitioner, steps, and job definition with associated listeners and tasklets.

methods.name: partitioner
methods.description: Creates and returns a LoanCOBPartitioner bean which partitions the loan COB workload based on certain properties.

methods.name: loanCOBStep
methods.description: Defines the partitioned step for executing loan COB processing, utilizing the partitioner.

methods.name: resolveCustomJobParametersStep
methods.description: Defines a step to resolve custom job parameters, using a tasklet and promotion listener.

methods.name: stayedLockedStep
methods.description: Defines a step handling stayed-locked loans, executing the stayedLockedTasklet.

methods.name: resolveCustomJobParametersTasklet
methods.description: Returns the tasklet responsible for resolving custom job parameters, scoped to a job.

methods.name: stayedLockedTasklet
methods.description: Returns a tasklet handling stayed locked loans, scoped to a job.

methods.name: loanCOBJob
methods.description: Assembles the main job combining the steps with listeners and incrementer for execution.

methods.name: customJobParametersPromotionListener
methods.description: Creates a listener to promote certain job parameters to the execution context.
